exports get                        GET     /api/v1/exports
exports download-get-by-export-id  GET     /api/v1/exports/{exportId}/download  exportId
reports get                        GET     /api/v1/reports
reports post                       POST    /api/v1/reports                      body:json
reports get-by-report-id           GET     /api/v1/reports/{reportId}           reportId
reports delete-by-report-id        DELETE  /api/v1/reports/{reportId}           reportId
